presentation.label: KIT A/B
presentation.summary: NO + PLAY becomes an A/B between the kit as edited and as saved.
presentation.overview: Kit A/B changes the single-kit reload. The first NO + PLAY (or RELOAD in the KIT menu) keeps your edits in a stash and loads the saved kit, with stock's popup KIT 1 RELOADED!. The next press puts the edits back and shows EDITS RESTORED!. Editing while the original plays ends the A/B: the next press keeps those edits instead, drops the stashed ones and reloads as a first press does. The same happens after a change of kit or any other reload. A press on a kit with no edits is a plain reload and arms nothing. Reloading every kit stays stock. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0010-kit-ab, with his code unchanged.
highlights: Compare the kit as edited with the kit as saved with one key.
Edits are stashed, not lost: the next press restores them.
Noticed by a checksum of the working kit, so a change of kit or an edit during the A/B ends it cleanly.
MrScruff's rytm-mods code, unchanged, linked by the elemod core.
usage: Use a build containing Kit A/B. Edit a sound on the loaded kit, for example BD DEC.
Press NO + PLAY: the screen shows KIT 1 RELOADED! and the saved value is back.
Press NO + PLAY again: EDITS RESTORED! and your edited value returns. The KIT menu's RELOAD (FUNC + PLAY MODE) does the same, with KIT RELOADED! in place of KIT 1 RELOADED!.

access.location: NO + PLAY on any screen that reloads the kit, and RELOAD in the KIT menu (FUNC + PLAY MODE).
steps: Edit a sound on the loaded kit.
Press NO + PLAY to hear the saved kit, and again to get your edits back.

controls.name: NO + PLAY, and KIT menu > RELOAD
controls.doc: First press: stash the edited kit and reload the saved one (KIT 1 RELOADED!). Next press: restore the stash (EDITS RESTORED!). A press on a kit with no edits is a plain reload.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3 or later.
One set of edits is kept: a stash of one kit, 2.5 KB (0x9e3 bytes) taken from the firmware's heap on the first press. If the allocation fails the press is a plain reload.
The restore applies the stash as stock's reload applies the saved kit, including kit_mark(working, 0), whose meaning is not established.

claims: ui:kit reload (NO + PLAY and the KIT menu's RELOAD)

load.display: None in the audio path: runs when a single kit is reloaded
load.conditions: Static: the sites replace the kit reload call and its popup text in the two single-kit reload paths. Nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. The stash takes 2,531 bytes of the firmware's heap on the first press. Not a measurement.

tests.summary: No hardware run of this module on OS 1.74 is recorded in this repository yet. Source: rytm2_mods' OS 1.74 file, unchanged. In the emulator, KIT menu > RELOAD after a BD DEC edit shows KIT RELOADED! with the saved kit, and a second RELOAD shows EDITS RESTORED! with the edit back; stock shows KIT RELOADED! twice and keeps the saved kit.
